chapterInfo.content:
2
Ɔboɔ a nkwa wɔ mu ne Ɔman kronkron
1 # Efe 4.22 Enti monyiyi bɔnepɛ nyinaa ne nnaadaa nyinaa ne nyaatwomyɛ ne nitan ne nsekuro nyinaa nto ngu, 2#Heb 5.12-13; Mat 18.3 na mompɛ asɛm no nufosuo kronkron mapa, sɛ nkɔkoaa a wɔawo wɔn seesei, na moanyini wɔ mu akɔ nkwagyeɛ mu, 3#Dwom 34.9 berɛ a moaka ahwɛ sɛ Awurade yam yɛ.
4 # Dwom 118.22 Ɔno na moba ne nkyɛn sɛ ɔboɔ a nkwa wɔ mu a nnipa apa no na Onyankopɔn deɛ, wafa no na ne boɔ yɛ den a, 5#Efe 2.21-22; 1 Pe 2.9; Rom 12.1 mo nso momma wɔmfa mo sɛ aboɔ a nkwa wɔ mu nto aban, na moayɛ honhom mu dan, asɔfokuo kronkron, sɛ mobɛbɔ honhom mu afɔdeɛ a ɛnam Yesu Kristo so sɔ Nyankopɔn ani. 6#Yes 28.16 Ɛfiri sɛ ɛwɔ atwerɛ no mu sɛ:
Hwɛ, mede tweaso tiboɔ
a wɔayie no na ne boɔ yɛ den mato Sion,
na deɛ ɔgye no die no ani renwu.
7 # Mat 21.42 Enti mo a mogye no die no, deɛ ɔsom boɔ no yɛ mo dea. Na wɔn a wɔnnye nnie no deɛ,
ɔboɔ a abantofoɔ apa no
na ayɛ tweaso tiboɔ
8 # Yes 8.14; Rom 9.33 ne suntiboɔ ne suntiduatoɔ botan ama wɔn.
Wɔn na wɔsunti,
ɛfiri sɛ wɔntie asɛm no.
Ɛno nti na wɔyii wɔn maeɛ.
9 # Eks 19.6; Adi 1.6 Na mo deɛ, moyɛ abusua a wɔayi wɔn, ahene asɔfokuo, ɔman kronkron, ɔman a wafa wɔn ayɛ ɔno ara ne deɛ, sɛ monka deɛ ɔfrɛɛ mo firi esum mu baa ne hann a ɛyɛ nwanwa mu no ayeyie nkyerɛ.
10 # Hos 2.23; Rom 9.25 Mo a kane no monyɛ ɔman,
na afei moayɛ Nyankopɔn man,
mo a monnyaa mmɔborɔhunu,
na afei deɛ, moanya mmɔborɔhunu.
Montena ase sɛ Onyankopɔn nkoa
11 # Dwom 39.12; Yak 4.1 Adɔfo, metu mo fo sɛ ahɔhoɔ ne amamfrafoɔ, sɛ monyi mo ho mfiri honam akɔnnɔ a ɛne ɔkra ko no ho, 12#Mat 5.16 na mommɔ bra pa amanaman mu, na deɛ wɔdi mo ho nsekuro wɔ mu sɛ nnebɔneyɛfoɔ no, wɔhwɛ mo nneyɛɛ pa no a, wɔahyɛ Onyankopɔn animuonyam, “nsra da” no.
13 # Rom 13.1-7; Tito 3.1 Mommrɛ mo ho ase mma nnipa tumidie nyinaa, Awurade nti: Ɔhene a ɔyɛ pumpuni oo, 14amradofoɔ a ɔsoma wɔn nnebɔneyɛfoɔ asotwe ne papayɛfoɔ ayeyie ho oo. 15#1 Pe 3.16 Na yei ne deɛ Onyankopɔn pɛ, sɛ mode papayɛ si nnipa a wɔnni adwene no nkwaseasɛm ano, 16#Gal 5.13 sɛ nnipa a wɔde wɔn ho, na ɛnyɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔde ahofadie no ayɛ bɔnepɛ so nkatasoɔ, na mmom sɛ Nyankopɔn nkoa. 17#Rom 12.10; Mmb 24.21; Mat 22.21 Monni nnipa nyinaa ni! Monnɔ anuanom! Monsuro Onyankopɔn! Monni ɔhene ni!
Kristo amanuhunu nhwɛsoɔ
18 # Efe 6.5; Tito 2.9 Nkoa, momfa suro nyinaa mmrɛ mo ho ase mma mo wuranom, ɛnyɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ na wɔdwoɔ nko, na wɔn a wɔhyɛ mo soɔ no nso bi. 19Na yei yɛ animuonyam, sɛ Nyankopɔn ho ahonim nti, obi de awerɛhoɔ hunu amane a ɛmfata no, nanso ɔgyina hɔ pintinn. 20#1 Pe 3.14; 3.17; 4.13-14; Mat 5.10 Na ɛyɛ animuonyam bɛn, sɛ mofom, na wɔbobɔ mo akuturuku, na moto mo bo ase gyeɛ? Na mmom sɛ moyɛ papa, na mohunu amane, na moto mo bo ase a, yei na ɛyɛ animuonyam, Nyankopɔn anim.
21 # Mat 16.24 Na yei na wɔbɔɔ din frɛɛ mo, ɛfiri sɛ Kristo nso hunuu amane maa mo gyaa mo nhwɛsoɔ sɛ monni n’anammɔn akyi.
22 # Yes 53.9; Yoh 8.46; 2 Ko 5.21 Ɔno na wanyɛ bɔne,
nanso wɔanhunu nnaadaa n’anomu.
23Ɔno na wɔyaa no, na wanya bie, ɔhunuu amane, nanso wanhunahuna, na mmom ɔde n’asɛm hyɛɛ deɛ ɔbu atɛntenenee no nsa. 24#1 Yoh 3.5; Rom 6.11 Ɔno ara na ɔsoaa yɛn bɔne wɔ ne honam mu kɔɔ dua no soɔ, sɛ, sɛ yɛawu ama nnebɔne a, yɛntena ase mma tenenee. Ɔno na wɔde ne mmaa ntampeɛ asa mo yadeɛ. 25#Yes 53.6; Hes 34.5; Yoh 10.12; 1 Pe 5.4 Na anka mote sɛ nnwan a wɔayera, na afei moasane aba mo kra Hwɛfoɔ ne Wɛmfoɔ no nkyɛn.

pageProps.chapterText:
Enti monyiyi bɔnepɛ nyinaa ne nnaadaa nyinaa ne nyaatwomyɛ ne nitan ne nsekuro nyinaa nto ngu, na mompɛ asɛm no nufosuo kronkron mapa, sɛ nkɔkoaa a wɔawo wɔn seesei, na moanyini wɔ mu akɔ nkwagyeɛ mu, berɛ a moaka ahwɛ sɛ Awurade yam yɛ.
Ɔno na moba ne nkyɛn sɛ ɔboɔ a nkwa wɔ mu a nnipa apa no na Onyankopɔn deɛ, wafa no na ne boɔ yɛ den a, mo nso momma wɔmfa mo sɛ aboɔ a nkwa wɔ mu nto aban, na moayɛ honhom mu dan, asɔfokuo kronkron, sɛ mobɛbɔ honhom mu afɔdeɛ a ɛnam Yesu Kristo so sɔ Nyankopɔn ani. Ɛfiri sɛ ɛwɔ atwerɛ no mu sɛ:
Hwɛ, mede tweaso tiboɔ
a wɔayie no na ne boɔ yɛ den mato Sion,
na deɛ ɔgye no die no ani renwu.
Enti mo a mogye no die no, deɛ ɔsom boɔ no yɛ mo dea. Na wɔn a wɔnnye nnie no deɛ,
ɔboɔ a abantofoɔ apa no
na ayɛ tweaso tiboɔ
ne suntiboɔ ne suntiduatoɔ botan ama wɔn.
Wɔn na wɔsunti,
ɛfiri sɛ wɔntie asɛm no.
Ɛno nti na wɔyii wɔn maeɛ.
Na mo deɛ, moyɛ abusua a wɔayi wɔn, ahene asɔfokuo, ɔman kronkron, ɔman a wafa wɔn ayɛ ɔno ara ne deɛ, sɛ monka deɛ ɔfrɛɛ mo firi esum mu baa ne hann a ɛyɛ nwanwa mu no ayeyie nkyerɛ.
Mo a kane no monyɛ ɔman,
na afei moayɛ Nyankopɔn man,
mo a monnyaa mmɔborɔhunu,
na afei deɛ, moanya mmɔborɔhunu.

Adɔfo, metu mo fo sɛ ahɔhoɔ ne amamfrafoɔ, sɛ monyi mo ho mfiri honam akɔnnɔ a ɛne ɔkra ko no ho, na mommɔ bra pa amanaman mu, na deɛ wɔdi mo ho nsekuro wɔ mu sɛ nnebɔneyɛfoɔ no, wɔhwɛ mo nneyɛɛ pa no a, wɔahyɛ Onyankopɔn animuonyam, “nsra da” no.
Mommrɛ mo ho ase mma nnipa tumidie nyinaa, Awurade nti: Ɔhene a ɔyɛ pumpuni oo, amradofoɔ a ɔsoma wɔn nnebɔneyɛfoɔ asotwe ne papayɛfoɔ ayeyie ho oo. Na yei ne deɛ Onyankopɔn pɛ, sɛ mode papayɛ si nnipa a wɔnni adwene no nkwaseasɛm ano, sɛ nnipa a wɔde wɔn ho, na ɛnyɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔde ahofadie no ayɛ bɔnepɛ so nkatasoɔ, na mmom sɛ Nyankopɔn nkoa. Monni nnipa nyinaa ni! Monnɔ anuanom! Monsuro Onyankopɔn! Monni ɔhene ni!

Nkoa, momfa suro nyinaa mmrɛ mo ho ase mma mo wuranom, ɛnyɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ na wɔdwoɔ nko, na wɔn a wɔhyɛ mo soɔ no nso bi. Na yei yɛ animuonyam, sɛ Nyankopɔn ho ahonim nti, obi de awerɛhoɔ hunu amane a ɛmfata no, nanso ɔgyina hɔ pintinn. Na ɛyɛ animuonyam bɛn, sɛ mofom, na wɔbobɔ mo akuturuku, na moto mo bo ase gyeɛ? Na mmom sɛ moyɛ papa, na mohunu amane, na moto mo bo ase a, yei na ɛyɛ animuonyam, Nyankopɔn anim.
Na yei na wɔbɔɔ din frɛɛ mo, ɛfiri sɛ Kristo nso hunuu amane maa mo gyaa mo nhwɛsoɔ sɛ monni n’anammɔn akyi.
Ɔno na wanyɛ bɔne,
nanso wɔanhunu nnaadaa n’anomu.
Ɔno na wɔyaa no, na wanya bie, ɔhunuu amane, nanso wanhunahuna, na mmom ɔde n’asɛm hyɛɛ deɛ ɔbu atɛntenenee no nsa. Ɔno ara na ɔsoaa yɛn bɔne wɔ ne honam mu kɔɔ dua no soɔ, sɛ, sɛ yɛawu ama nnebɔne a, yɛntena ase mma tenenee. Ɔno na wɔde ne mmaa ntampeɛ asa mo yadeɛ. Na anka mote sɛ nnwan a wɔayera, na afei moasane aba mo kra Hwɛfoɔ ne Wɛmfoɔ no nkyɛn.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
